Archive_Reason\__c has NONE of the three decided values. Fraud_Reason_\_c has three of four wrong, plus an undocumented 'Suspicious Betting Pattern' value nobody agreed.

Either the build drifted from the decision log, or the decision log is stale. A 5-minute check with Emily decides bug-fix vs decision-log amendment — do not guess, because whichever is wrong will resurface at UAT.

* Reconcile both value sets against the decision log

* Apply whichever is authoritative

* Update the decision log if the org turns out to be right

* Check no flow, formula or list view depends on the values being removed

Effort: \~1h.

Source: Asana Reconciliation v2, 2026-07-29, §3.

comments.body:
**UNBLOCKED — Open Questions Q1 resolved. Authoritative picklist values below.**

Source: Emily Vandenberg, Open Questions doc comments, 2026-07-24 20:05. Two separate picklists — the single combined 8-value PRD list is **not** what gets built.

**Fraud_Reason__c** (set by Rep/Ops when flagging a Sign Up)

1. Edited / Suspicious Screenshot _(singular — PRD had it plural)_

1. Duplicate Sign-Up

1. Suspicious Betting Pattern

1. Other (Fraud) — **requires free text**

**Archive_Reason__c** (set by Rep/Ops — equivalent to "Won't Do")

1. Unqualified Click

1. Dead Lead

1. Already Has Book

1. Not Interested

1. Locked Account – Unrecoverable

1. Other

**PRD values that survive nowhere — delete, do not migrate:** Outstanding Logs · Hedging / Low-Value Betting Pattern · Player Unavailable · Missed Deadline. Note `Locked Account` survives only as `Locked Account – Unrecoverable` on Archive Reason.

**Also in scope:**

* Validation rule: Fraud Reason Detail required when Fraud Reason = `Other (Fraud)`.

* Conditional visibility — Archive Reason on the archive path, Fraud Reason on the fraud path.

* Archive must be reachable at **two** points: straight from record creation, and after logging. Quick action available in both New and In Progress.

**Open:** Q11 decided that any click on an Archived Sign Up returns it to New — but did not say whether Archive Reason is cleared or retained for history. Matters for reporting. See BUILD-51.
Confirmed this is good in PartialSB.
